integrity: Primary mathematical proof and two independent exact finite enumeration methods are included. Literature comparison is non-exhaustive: the complete 2002 autosimilarity study was not accessible; no independent audit or external certification was performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact analysis of two finite-sampling designs and a completely classified first population-size threshold. No unconditional statement on species detection errors, independent unlimited-population draws, or all larger abundance configurations.
title: Sharp sampling-effort reversal in Jaccard autosimilarity
